statusHistory.note: Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30, article 3/30: researched English draft. Sourced beyond Time Out per standing rule: Attitude (LGBTQ+ press), London the Inside, official site, Instagram, Reddit. Google Maps confirmed current, open, LGBTQ+-friendly-tagged, 4.0/129 reviews read (recent and lowest) — mixed testimony including 'more sterile than the former Glory' and queue/smoking-area complaints, alongside praise for friendly staff. Reddit: r/downloadfestival DRAGLOAD event post and r/londonlgbt community context read directly. Official events calendar checked for September-November 2026 — genuinely dense, ongoing programme (LIPSYNC1000 Season 10, weekly cabaret/club nights); no specific dates used in body copy per dated-events-out-of-evergreen-copy. Direct successor to The Glory (Haggerston), same founders (Jonny Woo, John Sizzle, Colin Rothbart); internal link to the existing Dalston Superstore pin, its real neighbour in the same 'pink triangle' cluster. Pending: hero image resolution, five locale editions, full sign-offs, publish gates.

Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30: hero resolved (tier 1, owner-submitted Google Business photo — official site imagery was posters, Instagram/Facebook CDN links expire). Coordinator sign-off pass (near-tov-police/language-tic-police/near-legal-counsel/chief-editor lenses, chief editor mandatory per 2026-09-07 directive): no opening-line bans, headline avoids bare-name/formula, no process-as-copy, no rank-pulling. Legal: negative UGC (sterile vs. former Glory, queue/re-entry complaints) attributed to platform/reviewer and dated, no defamation-adjacent business allegation; no real-person likeness issue (public figures Jonny Woo/John Sizzle covered via their own public promotion of the venue, not a private fact). Link-density passes (Attitude/official site/Reddit in-text, internal NearLink to Dalston Superstore). Red team: no unverified prices stated as current (the one £10 entry figure appears only inside an attributed, dated UGC quote, not asserted as current fact); no internal jargon leaked. Discover audit clean. Revenue pass: no natural affiliate/ad-sales opportunity for a door-charge nightlife venue beyond existing coverage; logged none. Five locale editions written (pt-BR, it, es-ES, es-419, zh-CN), each genuine and >=150 words, each with its own publishNote.
